transformations.session-allowlist-v1: Retain factual session metadata; drop raw responses/result_events/raw_usage/command_shape. Numeric fields used by evaluators retained unchanged.
transformations.local-location-replacement-v1: Replace private filesystem prefixes in copies only; recorded hashes remain historical, not recomputed.
transformations.private-parent-name-v1: Remove private parent project name from copies only.

integrity_policy: Original frozen manifests are never rewritten. Public per-file hashes verify derived bytes. Historical hashes for omitted/derived files cannot be verified from this package; the offline receipt reports that coverage. Do not label derived session records as original frozen records.
reproduction_policy: Compare every scientific result recursively; ignore only explicit volatile provenance fields, never scores, observed counts, timing measurements of retained runs or classifications. Scripted rerun runtimes are new measurements, not replacements for recorded timing.
omission_policy: Raw provider streams and bridge prose are excluded for privacy/rights. Operational events preserve actions, enum dispositions, real check outputs and commit snapshots; arbitrary free-text/chain-of-thought claims cannot be reanalyzed.
deferred_phase: access-study requires a NEW explicit rights/privacy inventory, preserved authors/licenses and separate authorization. Never append it through this allowlist.
known_source_consistency_issue: Historical stale aggregate corrected by coordinator; the exact stale backup and correction provenance remain in results/aggregate-history. Current aggregate must match current phase results and the recorded canonical hash.
historical_audit_procedure: The empirical audit uses the preserved previous-expanded-results frame, whose only difference from the current phase result is evaluated_at. This is verified before using it temporarily in a disposable copy. Current result bytes are restored immediately afterward. No observations or classifications are replaced.
